dimensions.assessment: Affects all children and teens using covered internet platforms, as well as platform operators and technology companies conducting user research.
dimensions.evidence: A covered platform may not, in the case of a user or visitor that the covered platform knows is a child, conduct market or product-focused research on such child.

dimensions.assessment: Places strict prohibitions and consent requirements on how internet platforms interact with and study minor users.
dimensions.evidence: A covered platform may not, in the case of a user or visitor that the online platform knows is a teen, conduct market or product-focused research on such teen, unless the covered platform obtains verifiable parental consent

dimensions.assessment: Enforcement is handled through existing FTC and State Attorney General mechanisms without specified new spending appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall enforce this Act in the same manner, by the same means, and with the same jurisdiction, powers, and duties as though all applicable terms and provisions of the Federal Trade Commission Act

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a novel statutory prohibition on minor research, grants enforcement powers to the FTC and State Attorneys General, and preempts state laws relating to its provisions.
dimensions.evidence: No State or political subdivision of a State may prescribe, maintain, or enforce any law... if such law... relates to the provisions of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent prohibitions and regulatory standards taking effect 90 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall take effect on the date that is 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits market or product-focused research on children under 13 on covered internet platforms and restricts such research on teens without verifiable parental consent, enforced by the FTC and State Attorneys General.
